description: DB-backed regression for alga-2026-0002632 (extend server/src/test/integration/email/passwordRecoveryEmailProvider.integration.test.ts): same email is an active client user in tenants A and B, each with an active portal domain. recoverPassword with A's portalDomain sends exactly one email, through tenant A, whose token names A's user; repeat for B. Run in both insert orders so row order cannot pass it.
DB-backed redemption: with the two-tenant fixture, setNewPassword with A's token changes only A's user's hash and leaves B's untouched; getAccountInfoFromToken returns A's user's name. Repeat for B.

Unhinted fan-out: client email in two tenants with no hint sends two emails, one per tenant, each token bound to its own user and each client-portal link carrying its own tenant's portal domain; an SSO-required or inactive subject is skipped without suppressing the other.

Hint edge cases (unit, resolveResetSubjects): hint resolves to a tenant where the email has no user -> no subjects; unknown host or malformed slug -> treated as no hint; single match with no hint -> that subject; inactive users never become subjects.

Token redemption guards (unit): token whose user was deactivated, whose email changed, or whose tenant/user_id do not exist is refused; legacy token without tenant is accepted with one cross-tenant match and refused with two.

Enumeration safety and rate limit: recoverPassword returns the same value for match, no match, hint mismatch, fan-out and over-limit; over the per-email limit no email is sent. Existing non-match and provider-failure cases in the integration suite still pass.
Sign-in unaffected by the move: existing packages/auth/src/actions/auth.tenantScoping.test.ts passes against the shared portal-domain tenant resolver.

MSP hint: scoped MSP sign-in renders the forgot-password link with ?tenant=<slug>; the forgot-password page passes the slug to recoverPassword; an internal email in two tenants with the slug hint sends only that tenant's email.
